summary: Radar for 2026-11-09, GLP-1 focus. Two hooks with a set date lead: (1) the Thanksgiving-on-tirzepatide question, which climbed for 10 snapshots in a row (80 → 90) ahead of the Nov 18–27 peak, and (2) the full retatrutide knee osteoarthritis Phase 3 results. TRIUMPH-4 and TRIUMPH-1-OA were published in NEJM and presented at ACR on Nov 8 (Medical Xpress). They show about two-thirds reaching ≥50% knee-pain reduction vs 38% on placebo. The topline came out in Dec 2025, so call this the full publication, not 'new' results. I found no YouTube coverage of it yet. The Lane A practical queue (injection site, dehydration, diarrhoea, alcohol, burping/heartburn) is still the main earner. Fresh research hooks this week: a Diabetes Obes Metab target-trial emulation on semaglutide/tirzepatide and alcohol-related outcomes in type 2 diabetes (Nov 3), a pharmacy-journal cohort on NSAIDs and GI bleeding on GLP-1s (Nov 5), NewsNation's allodynia ('my skin hurts') story (Nov 6), and new eye-safety coverage. ObesityWeek (Nov 14–17) is the next event window: REDEFINE 4, CagriSema vs tirzepatide, is the only news a long-form may use. Rejected: the Hims & Hers / LifeMD / online-platform sales stories, the employer-insurance and Medicaid $50 cost stories, and the 'golden dose' pen-hack angle. Note: the PubMed record for the alcohol study didn't load (cookie wall), so its effect sizes must be fetched before scripting.

candidates.topic: Thanksgiving on tirzepatide: feeling full fast, protein first, smaller plates, eating slowly, alcohol and easing nausea at a big holiday meal
candidates.angle: Calm 'Will I be able to enjoy Thanksgiving on tirzepatide?' answer. Delayed gastric emptying explains the early fullness, then a practical plate plan (protein first, small portions, slow pace, gentle on fatty and fried foods, sip water). 20:00 funnel Shorts feed the existing Thanksgiving long-form. Prescriber line, no dosing or skipping-dose advice.
candidates.why_now: Fixed seasonal spike. Seen in 10 straight snapshots with momentum rising every time (80 → 90). Our Thanksgiving long-form (17 min) needs feeder Shorts before demand arrives.

evidence.signal: Label describes delayed gastric emptying and GI side effects (nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea) as most common

candidates.topic: Retatrutide for knee osteoarthritis: full Phase 3 results (TRIUMPH-4 and TRIUMPH-1-OA, NEJM + ACR 2026, Nov 8). About two-thirds had ≥50% knee-pain reduction vs 38% on placebo, with mean weight loss around 25% at the highest dose
candidates.angle: 13:00 'What's confirmed?' Short: what the published Phase 3 data show (population: adults with overweight/obesity and knee OA, more than 1,000 people across the two trials), what's still unknown, and a plain line that retatrutide isn't approved and online 'research' products aren't the trial drug. Tirzepatide-first viewers get context: separate trials, not head-to-head.
candidates.why_now: NEJM publication and ACR presentation on Nov 8, picked up within 24 h by Medical Xpress, News-Medical, NewsBytes, New Atlas and Bioengineer. Sky News and MedPage are also running 'one click away' retatrutide pieces, so search for retatrutide is rising. No YouTube explainers found yet. Note: TRIUMPH-4 topline was Dec 2025, so frame this as the full peer-reviewed results, not 'new'.

evidence.signal: TRIUMPH-4 and TRIUMPH-1-OA Phase 3, NEJM, ACR; ~2/3 with ≥50% pain reduction vs 38% placebo

candidates.topic: Tirzepatide dehydration: signs to watch for. The label warns of acute kidney injury linked to dehydration from vomiting or diarrhoea
candidates.angle: Long-form 'Tirzepatide Dehydration: Signs to Watch For'. Why reduced thirst and appetite plus GI losses add up, early signs (dark urine, dizziness, dry mouth, peeing less), practical habits (sip through the day, fluids with food), and when it's urgent. Uses the label's kidney warning word for word. Help-line wording covers all four markets.
candidates.predicted_peak: steady; Australian summer adds lift Dec–Feb
candidates.why_now: Momentum rose from 70 to 80 across 4 snapshots. It's #2 in the playbook's Lane A queue, and Australian summer heat is a seasonal hook.

evidence.signal: Warnings and precautions: acute kidney injury, reported with dehydration from GI adverse reactions

The low-blood-sugar caveat for people on insulin or sulfonylureas. Then the research: observational data linking GLP-1 medicines to fewer recorded alcohol-related problems, kept at 'linked to'. Timely before holiday drinking season.
